targets.notes: On 13 Nov 2026 Fetch returned bot_blocked for this B&H product URL. A partner card, not the Founders Edition, so it alerts only if the price is at or under $2,500.

N=4131 is Newegg's In Stock filter. On 13 Nov 2026 Fetch returned the page: 13 graphics cards in stock, cheapest $6,709.99, mixed with whole PCs. The parser keeps graphics cards and ignores desktops, so this target stops at Fetch and does not alert (the cheapest card is over $2,500). The Agent is only there if the markup changes and stock can no longer be read.
